first_batch.output: One measurement dependency diagram/table: primitive observations, derived duty/flow, Type A/B components, covariance, unknown calibration quantities.

first_batch.scope: Sections 2–4 and the model hierarchy; start with 4.1–4.2.

first_batch.output: Nested-state/parameter table, residual assumptions, physical plausibility checks and held-out assessment requirements; flag conditions for likelihood-ratio testing.

first_batch.scope: S23 problem/observation/profile-likelihood construction and examples; S06 calibration/discrepancy example and conclusions.

first_batch.output: Identifiability/confounding checklist for selected model and observations; separate mathematical non-identifiability from data-limited uncertainty and discrepancy.

first_batch.scope: Sections 2–3 first; then CFD-check design in Section 4. Read as arXiv v1, not as a fully compared journal copy.

first_batch.output: State/energy/momentum/closure comparison to M1/M2/M3; assumption and conservation checks; coupled-loop and boundary-condition transfer limits.

acquisition_requests.needed_version: Full 2025 journal article, Nuclear Technology 211(9), 2135–2144, plus any supplementary uncertainty/data material. A clearly identified accepted manuscript is acceptable for initial extraction; retain final-version comparison as a task.
acquisition_requests.citation: Jadyn Reis and Yassin Hassan (2025). SAM Code Validation for High Prandtl Number Flow in Molten Salt Natural Circulation Facility. Nuclear Technology 211(9), 2135–2144.
acquisition_requests.inspect: Input and boundary-condition definitions (net heat input and minimum loop temperature); heat-transfer/friction closures; experimental friction-factor derivation; data used for fitting versus assessment; velocity and temperature-difference results; property and measurement uncertainty. Section/equation numbers not known until acquired.
acquisition_requests.decision: Decide the fair comparator for autonomous temperature/circulation prediction and whether proposed closure learning adds evidence beyond calibrated high-Pr SAM.
acquisition_requests.why_not_abstract: The ANS abstract identifies prescribed inputs and friction-factor comparison but cannot resolve fitting/assessment independence, derivations, uncertainty propagation or the precise operating regimes. S17 and S35 provide context, not this article’s complete method.
acquisition_requests.attempts: ANS citation/abstract verified; Taylor & Francis PDF returned HTTP 403; full-text route failed; author laboratory publication list links to publisher, not an accessible manuscript; ResearchGate offers request-full-text only.
acquisition_requests.if_unavailable: First batch proceeds using S17/S18/S35. Keep S16-specific prediction, closure and novelty comparisons unresolved; no claim of surpassing it.
acquisition_requests.alternative: S17 is a system-code comparator with different fluid/facility; S35 is external CFD with related experimental context. Neither replaces the exact high-Pr SAM comparison.
acquisition_requests.user_action: Upload a legally obtained PDF/accepted manuscript and available supplement; university library or an author-provided copy is suitable. No account credentials needed.

acquisition_requests.needed_version: Original 2002 journal article, Nuclear Engineering and Design 215(1–2), 139–152; complete figures, symbol definitions and correlation derivations. Identified author manuscript is acceptable.
acquisition_requests.citation: P. K. Vijayan (2002). Experimental observations on the general trends of the steady state and stability behaviour of single-phase natural circulation loops. Nuclear Engineering and Design 215(1–2), 139–152.
acquisition_requests.inspect: Dimensional/non-dimensional momentum and energy balances; geometry and non-uniform-diameter extension; heat-source/sink assumptions; friction regimes; experimental stability maps and limits; uncertainty and correlation validity. Numbering not yet known.
acquisition_requests.decision: Determine which circulation scaling and stability statements are justified for M3, and which similarity conditions a surrogate-to-salt claim would need.
acquisition_requests.why_not_abstract: A broad steady-state/stability summary does not supply group definitions, correlation ranges or conditions separating steady similarity from stability/transient similarity. Those are the actual engineering restrictions we need.
acquisition_requests.attempts: Publisher metadata/abstract verified but full page fetch blocked/non-content response; exact-title, PDF and IAEA/INIS searches found citations rather than the target full paper; ResearchGate request-only. An IAEA handbook alternative was located but its PDF could not be retrieved here.
acquisition_requests.if_unavailable: Use S18/S17 for their own model assumptions. Delay use of this paper’s correlations and broad natural-circulation scaling/stability claims; seek an independently read primary replacement.
acquisition_requests.alternative: S18 supplies a different conjugate coupled-loop model; S17 supplies a different experimental system-code assessment. Neither reproduces the original experimental scaling/stability evidence.
acquisition_requests.user_action: Upload the complete article or obtain it through library document delivery/interlibrary loan. A PDF with legible plots and equations matters more than publisher typesetting.

acquisition_requests.priority: P1 before any network-discovery novelty claim
acquisition_requests.needed_version: Latest accepted manuscript or version of record for IJTS 230, 111148, including supplementary method/results; optionally SSRN:5936610 (posted 18 December 2025) for version comparison. December 2026 is the assigned issue date, not a verified online-publication date.
acquisition_requests.citation: Sreehari Manikkan, Panagiota Karava and Ilias Bilionis (2026 assigned issue). Entropy switch for Bayesian thermal network discovery. International Journal of Thermal Sciences 230, 111148.
acquisition_requests.inspect: Network parameterization and switch; prior on topology/parameters; observation/noise model; synthetic identifiability/observability cases; model selection versus prediction; uncertainty calibration and held-out evidence; applicability beyond reciprocal RC heat exchange. No section/equation numbers assumed.
acquisition_requests.decision: Test whether H01/H02 add anything beyond existing Bayesian thermal-network discovery and whether an advective loop exposes a different, defensible question.
acquisition_requests.why_not_abstract: The abstract establishes an existing approach, not its constraints or demonstrated limits. The public author repository reproduces a synthetic 4R3C example; it is not the complete paper, proofs, building cases or supplement.
acquisition_requests.attempts: Publisher indexed metadata/abstract verified; direct full page/PDF route blocked or returned non-content HTML. SSRN landing/delivery did not yield a PDF. Author GitHub README read; author-advertised free-access link also attempted, outcome recorded in retrieval log.
acquisition_requests.if_unavailable: Continue S08/S06/S23 baseline work. Keep network-discovery novelty and method preference unresolved; do not adopt or dismiss the method from README/abstract alone.
acquisition_requests.alternative: S08 is a usable simpler model-selection baseline; S06/S23 address confounding/identifiability. They do not establish what this competing topology-discovery method has already achieved.
acquisition_requests.user_action: Upload the latest manuscript and supplement if accessible. If only the 2025 SSRN version is available, upload it with its version/date; we can extract it under that label and retain a final-version comparison task.

acquisition_requests.priority: P2 conditional on pursuing local-flow or recirculation contribution
acquisition_requests.needed_version: Complete journal/accepted manuscript for NED 459, 115179 with near-wall/full-field PIV figures and uncertainty supplement. Establish online date and exact version; December 2026 issue assignment is in the future relative to this search.
acquisition_requests.citation: Thomas Carson, Hansol Kim, Joseph Seo, Theodore Kupper, Cole Gentry, Kevin Clarno and Yassin Hassan (2026 assigned issue). Experimental flow visualization and thermal-hydraulic characterization of local heating effects in a molten salt natural circulation loop. Nuclear Engineering and Design 459, 115179.
acquisition_requests.inspect: Local heating protocol; PIV window/spatial and time resolution; near-wall uncertainty and masking; definitions of local counterflow/recirculation; relation to local thermal measurements; which mechanisms were observed versus inferred. Numbering not known.
acquisition_requests.decision: Assess whether H03 could add a supported local thermal result and what evidence a recirculation-extent claim would require.
acquisition_requests.why_not_abstract: The abstract/highlights establish PIV/local-heating precedent but cannot establish recirculation extent, resolution limits, uncertainty or a measured heat-transfer effect. S35 is CFD/earlier experiments, not this evidence.
acquisition_requests.attempts: Publisher indexed title/authors/DOI/article metadata verified; page fetch blocked and direct response contained no paper. Exact-title/author and institutional discovery did not identify a retrievable matching manuscript.
acquisition_requests.if_unavailable: Do not hold the core reading batch. Keep local-flow novelty and quantitative recirculation/heat-transfer promises out of the proposal until this and the project evidence gate are resolved.
acquisition_requests.alternative: Read available S35 for external CFD/observation limitations. S19/S20 are later comparator leads; they require their own acquisition checks and are not established substitutes.
acquisition_requests.user_action: Only if local recirculation remains a serious candidate: upload an author-provided/accepted/final PDF and supplement, or obtain a copy through your library. Not needed to start the core batch.
